newsitem.title: USA: Hyperion Capital to settle suit for $5 million.
newsitem.headline: Hyperion Capital to settle suit for $5 million.

text.p: Hyperion 1997 Term Trust Inc said on Tuesday that its investment advisor, Hyperion Capital Management Inc, agreed to pay $5 million before plaintiff's legal fees to settle a class action suit.
The settlement is to be allocated among non-excluded investors who bought Hyperion 1997 stock from Oct. 23, 1992 to Oct. 8, 1993, the company said in a news release.
A court has given preliminary approval to the settlement. Still to come is a hearing regarding legal fees.
The suit named as defendants Hyperion 1997, Hyperion Capital Management, certain directors and officers of both, and underwriters that participated in Hyperion 1997's initial public offering.

The suit, entitled Moelis vs Hyperion Capital Management, was one of a number of class action suits filed against Hyperion alleging securities fraud. The other suits all have been dismissed, Hyperion 1997 said.
Hyperion 1997 is a closed-end investment company with a scheduled termination date of Nov. 30, 1997. It invests mostly in U.S. Treasury securities.
